# anthropic_environment (Data Source)

Looks up one Managed Agents environment by id or name.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_environment" "ci" {
  name = "ci-runners"
}

output "ci_environment_id" {
  value = data.anthropic_environment.ci.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Environment id. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Environment name (unique among live environments).

### Read-Only

- `allow_mcp_servers` (Boolean) Whether MCP server traffic is allowed under limited networking.
- `allow_package_managers` (Boolean) Whether package-manager traffic is allowed under limited networking.
- `allowed_hosts` (List of String) Allowed hosts under limited networking.
- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata.
- `networking_type` (String) `unrestricted` or `limited`; null for self-hosted.
- `packages` (Map of List of String) Pre-installed packages keyed by ecosystem (`apt`, `cargo`, `gem`, `go`, `npm`, `pip`).
- `scope` (String) `organization` or `account`.
- `type` (String) `cloud` or `self_hosted`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
